description: A spinning wheel of names — paste a list, spin, and get one fair winner. A HelpySelf tool (helpyself.com).

draws.description: How many winners to draw. Without removeWinner each draw is from the full list, so the same name can win more than once. Defaults to 1.

names.description: The entries to draw from, one per line. Blank lines and surrounding spaces are ignored; a name listed twice has two chances.

removeWinner.description: Take each winner out of the list before the next draw, so no name wins twice. Drawing stops early if the list runs out; remaining in the response lists who is left.

name: wheel_of_names
title: Wheel of Names
